title: Library biome
description: One of our own biomes, built from vanilla 26.3 blocks and feature types: compiler/src/main/resources/customdimensions/biomes/<id>.json. Every compile writes it into the pack as <namespace>:<id>, its features as <namespace>:biome/<id>/<name>. Rules: docs/design/rebuild-26/worldgen.md#biome-library.

inspiredBy.description: One sentence naming what inspired the biome.

differs.description: One sentence on how it differs from vanilla, in look and behaviour.

biome.description: A 26.3 biome file, shaped as vanilla's data/minecraft/worldgen/biome/*.json. In features, "~<name>" names one of this biome's own features.

attributes.description: Environment attributes by id: music, ambient sounds, particles, fog and sky colours, mob spawns.

carvers.description: A vanilla carver id, or a list of them.

effects.description: water_color, and optionally grass_color, foliage_color, dry_foliage_color and grass_color_modifier.

features.description: Placed features by generation step, at most 11 steps: vanilla placed feature ids or ~<name>.
The biome's own features by name: a configured feature (or a vanilla configured feature id) and its placement.

oneOf.description: A 26.3 configured feature, shaped as vanilla's worldgen/feature/*.json.

placement.description: Placement modifiers, as in vanilla's worldgen/placed_feature/*.json.

palette.description: The surface palette, applied under a minecraft:biome condition in every dimension whose biomes include this one; the definition's own materials.biomes entry for it wins.

role.description: The ground the biome belongs to, which decides where a biomeLayout of regions may put it; absent: cave for the caves realm, else land.

climate.description: The multi-noise box a definition's layout uses when it lists the biome without one: a point or [min, max] per axis, absent axes everything.

featureRef.description: A vanilla id, or ~<name> for one of this biome's own features.
